messages.text: Norris claims Sao Paulo GP pole after treacherous rain-hit qualifying

metadata.summary: Lando Norris claimed pole position after a hugely-challenging Sao Paulo Grand Prix qualifying in treacherous wet conditions, for a race that will see Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen start at the back of the grid.
metadata.content: Sao Paulo GP Qualifying: Lando Norris claims rain-hit pole in wild conditions with Lewis Hamilton, Max Verstappen to start at back | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Breaking Sao Paulo GP Qualifying: Lando Norris claims rain-hit pole in wild conditions with Lewis Hamilton, Max Verstappen to start at back Lando Norris tames awful wet conditions for his third Brazil pole in a row; Frustrated Russell drops down from second with grid penalty; Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen starting 20th and 21st; watch Sunday's Sao Paulo GP live at 5pm on Sky Sports F1, build-up from 3.30pm Saturday 7 November 2026 21:50, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Grand Prix. Lando Norris claimed pole position after a hugely-challenging Sao Paulo Grand Prix qualifying in treacherous wet conditions, for a race that will see Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen start at the back of the grid. On a typically rain-hit day at ever-unpredictable Interlagos, qualifying was suspended for over an hour and 20 minutes after a torrential downpour hit the drivers' first laps of Q1. The rain eventually eased - but never particularly stopped - to allow running take place and create a thrilling and unpredictable battle for pole. messages.text: Hits and misses: Could Konsa hold off Saliba's return?

metadata.content: Could Arsenal's Ezri Konsa hold off William Saliba from reuniting partnership with Gabriel? Premier League hits and misses | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Could Arsenal's Ezri Konsa hold off William Saliba from reuniting partnership with Gabriel? Premier League hits and misses Sky Sports' football writers analyse Friday and Saturday's Premier League action as Ezri Konsa shows why he can keep William Saliba out of Arsenal's line-up on his return; 'Toothless' Spurs show why they're not back yet and why Coventry have a lot to like despite defeat Saturday 7 November 2026 21:31, UK Konsa showing he could hold off Saliba Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player FREE TO WATCH: Highlights from Arsenal’s match against Hull in the Premier League. Arsenal did not produce a vintage attacking display against Hull but defensively there were few faults. Their seventh clean sheet in 10 Premier League games, and 10th in 16 overall, owed a lot to their centre-backs. Gabriel and Ezri Konsa excelled again. William Saliba's impending return will put pressure on Konsa to retain his place but on current form he may keep hold of the shirt. Highlights from his display included a last-ditch block on Mohamed Ali-Cho when was suddenly exposed on the break.
